yaml:
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-sideeffect
spec:
  native: true
  concurrency:
    mutex: edge-mutex
  agentSelector:
    - kind:linux
  steps:
    - name: append
      run: for i in $(seq 1 120); do echo "run,$i,$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)" >> /data/sideeffect.log; sleep 1; done
